# Cass Art

> > Cass Art is the UK's leading retailer of quality art supplies and materials from premium international brands.

Cass Art offers a comprehensive range of professional artist materials including paints, pencils, papers, and studio equipment from renowned manufacturers such as Winsor & Newton, Daler-Rowney, Faber-Castell, and Schmincke. The company operates physical stores across London and provides detailed brand profiles to help artists select the right materials for their practice.

## Key Topics

- Art supplies
- Watercolour paints
- Artist pencils
- Acrylic paints
- Oil paints
- Art paper
- Brand profiles
- Winsor & Newton
- Daler-Rowney

- Studio equipment

## Premium Paint Brands

- [Winsor & Newton](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand/winsor-newton/about): Winsor & Newton brand profile: historic 1832 art materials manufacturer
- [Schmincke](https://www.cassart.co.uk/schmincke-range): Schmincke brand: German watercolours, oils and pastels for professionals
- [Daler-Rowney](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand/daler-rowney/about): Daler-Rowney brand overview: premium paints, brushes, and art papers
- [Golden Artist Colors](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand/golden/about): Golden Artist Colors: professional acrylic paints and mediums
- [Liquitex](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand/liquitex/about): Liquitex brand: leading acrylic paints with bio-based and sustainable options
- [Michael Harding](https://www.cassart.co.uk/michael-harding-range): Michael Harding oil paints and mediums: premium artist paint range

## Drawing & Writing Tools

- [Faber-Castell](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand/faber-castell/about): Faber-Castell brand: world-renowned pencil manufacturer with artist ranges
- [Derwent](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand/derwent/about): Derwent brand: UK-based artist pencils including Inktense and Lightfast
- [Caran D'Ache](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brand-caran-dache-about): Caran D'Ache brand: Swiss luxury coloured pencils and stationery
- [Posca Paint Pens](https://www.cassart.co.uk/posca-range): Posca paint pens: water-based multi-surface markers for artists

## Paper & Surfaces

- [Arches Fine Art Paper](https://www.cassart.co.uk/arches-range): Arches fine art paper range: artist-quality watercolour and drawing papers
- [Fabriano](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brands/fabriano): Fabriano Italian papers: traditional watercolour and sketching pads
- [Pith Sustainable Sketchbooks](https://www.cassart.co.uk/pith-range): Pith sustainable sketchbooks: eco-friendly British-made artist notebooks

## Studio Equipment & Spray Paints

- [Mabef Artist Easels](https://www.cassart.co.uk/mabef-range): Mabef brand: Italian artist easels and studio equipment for 60 years
- [Montana Spray Paints](https://www.cassart.co.uk/brands/montana): Montana spray paints: German artist-quality paints for street art
